comment: Example only. Vendor-neutral names. A site file lives in the NF app option, not in this repo. Each VAV names its override strategy; boxes without a strategy are auto-detected from writable roles.

vav_override.comment: Vendor A: the box exposes a BACnet-writable airflow setpoint.
Vendor B: no writable airflow setpoint; a boolean flush / max-flow point drives the box to maximum cooling.
Vendor B variant: an enumerated box-mode point. Release writes the release value, then the command is cancelled.
